title: SaneCite retraction census: post-retraction citations to 22,553 retracted biomedical papers (protocol, code and data)
description: Census of how retracted biomedical papers are cited after retraction. Every Retraction Watch retraction with a PubMed ID, retracted 1990-2023 (22,553 papers); 55,676 later citations read in open-access papers (51,614 judged, after the 20 Oct 2026 correction); each citing passage labelled by a three-model panel (cited as support, passing mention, flagged as retracted or unreliable). Includes the pre-registered protocol with all eleven dated amendments and the dated correction notes (15 and 20 Oct 2026), all analysis code, validation sets, every model label and every citing passage. Figures are provisional until a human labelling round. Results: https://sanecite.com/campaign-one.html; searchable data: https://sanecite.com/data.html. License: SaneCite-made data under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA) and code under MIT (LICENSE); quoted passages remain under each source article's license, and Retraction Watch records under the terms of Crossref and Retraction Watch. Includes the census errata (errata/).
